sections.title: A. Read the passage and decide whether each statement below is True (T) or False (F). (1.25 điểm)
sections.introHtml:
PHOENIX EDUCATION

Phoenix Education is an international school for students from kindergarten to high school. It is located on Nguyen Hoang Street, Hue City, Vietnam. The school looks like a castle, with a large playground and a nice small swimming pool. Here students enjoy learning English with native teachers. These teachers come from many parts of the world such as Australia, the United States and England. They are very friendly and helpful. On Western holidays, the school often organizes parties with a variety of foods and fun activities which thrill students, boys and girls alike.

sections.title: B: Choose the correct word A, B or C to fill each blank in the following passage. (1.25 điểm)
sections.introHtml: My name is Ha and my best friend is Hoa. She is my classmate. We are both in grade 6 at Quang Trung Secondary School. Hoa lives next to my house. Every day, my father takes us to school by his motorbike and we come home on foot in the evening. My sister is an intelligent girl. Her favorite subject is Maths, and she is really good at it. We usually help each other with our homework. Whenever I am sad, Hoa always tells me funny stories to make me happy. I feel very lucky to have a best friend like Hoa.
